edges.reason: Ownable constructor derives initial owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
msg.sender is the value written into the privileged owner slot.
owner state variable is assigned from msg.sender without further authorization.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before renouncing ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates revoke with msg.sender.
owner is read by the onlyOwner equality check and then overwritten.
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0), dropping all privileges.
owner is used as the recipient of the refunded tokens in revoke.
owner address flows into the external token transfer in revoke.
_transferOwnership reads and rewrites the owner state variable.
_transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner variable.
transferOwnership delegates control flow to _transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
_newOwner is forwarded to the internal transfer routine.
_newOwner parameter is validated and written into owner.
_beneficiary parameter flows into the vesting constructor.
_start parameter flows into the vesting constructor.
_cliff parameter flows into the vesting constructor.
_duration parameter flows into the vesting constructor.
_revocable parameter flows into the vesting constructor.
beneficiary state variable is initialized from _beneficiary.
revocable state variable is initialized from _revocable.
duration state variable is initialized from _duration.
start state variable is initialized from _start.
_start is an operand of the cliff addition.
_cliff is added to _start to compute the cliff timestamp.
cliff state variable receives the unchecked schedule arithmetic result.
block.timestamp is the miner-influenced driver of the vested amount computation.
cliff participates in the block.timestamp branch condition.
start participates in the start.add(duration) branch condition.
duration bounds the linear vesting window.
revoked[token] short-circuits the vesting computation.
totalBalance is derived from the observed currentBalance.
released[token] is added into totalBalance.
block.timestamp is subtracted from start in the vesting rounding math.
start is the subtrahend in block.timestamp.sub(start).
The 3600-second gap is used to floor the elapsed time.
start_gap receives the rounded elapsed-time arithmetic result.
start_gap is an operand of the pro-rata vesting multiplication.
totalBalance is multiplied by start_gap to derive the vested amount.
duration is the divisor in the pro-rata vesting computation.
vestedAmount returns the timestamp-derived pro-rata value.
revoke makes an external call to the untrusted ERC20 balanceOf implementation.
token parameter selects the balanceOf target in the external call.
balance local is assigned from the external balanceOf result.
revoke performs an external token transfer to the token contract.
token parameter selects the target of the refund transfer.
refund amount flows into the external transfer call.
revoke calls releasableAmount to size the vested portion.
releasableAmount result is stored in the unreleased local.
balance is the minuend of the refund subtraction.
unreleased is the subtrahend of the refund subtraction.
refund local receives the subtraction result.
revoked[token] is set true, permanently changing the vesting state.
release performs an external token transfer to an untrusted ERC20 implementation.
beneficiary is the recipient of the released tokens.
token parameter selects the transfer target in release.
unreleased amount flows into the external transfer call.
release calls releasableAmount to determine the payout.
releasableAmount calls vestedAmount for the vested total.
vestedAmount makes an external call to the untrusted ERC20 balanceOf implementation.
token parameter selects the balanceOf target inside vestedAmount.
currentBalance is assigned from the external balanceOf result.
vestedAmount result is the minuend of the releasable subtraction.
released[token] is the subtrahend of the releasable subtraction.
releasableAmount returns the subtraction of already-released tokens.
unreleased local receives the releasableAmount result in release.
release declares and initializes the unreleased local.
unreleased is added into the released accounting mapping.
released[token] is the accumulator of the payout accounting.
token parameter indexes the released mapping update.
released[token] state is updated with the new total.
release accepts the token parameter it operates on.
revoke accepts the token parameter it operates on.
releasableAmount accepts the token parameter it queries.
vestedAmount accepts the token parameter it queries.
release routes the transfer through SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
revoke routes the refund through SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
safeTransfer invokes the untrusted ERC20 transfer implementation.
safeTransfer token parameter is used for the external call.
safeTransfer pairs token with recipient to/from.
safeTransfer pairs token with value amount.
